name: Smaart Tech Services Limited
about: Smaart Tech Services Limited manufactures consumer electronics products. The company offers color televisions, LED televisions, and air conditioners. It also provides feasibility study services to group companies. Smaart Tech Services Limited was formerly known as Sharp India Limited and changed its name to Smaart Tech Services Limited in July 2026. Smaart Tech Services Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Pune, India. As of June3, 2026, Smaart Tech Services Limited operates as a subsidiary of Brisk India Private Limited.
